title: KEYCARDS IN THE WORLD
why: His order of 2026-10-12, 32: more interiors. The third vault build. Every DEMO raid now hides one Vault Keycard per vault in an ordinary crate, locker or safe that you can reach, never inside a locked room. Fights pay them out too: while a vault is still shut, every elite you kill drops a KEYCARD box where it fell, and so does every twelfth kill when no keycard is left in the world. Opening a vault pays VAULT OPEN plus 500 to the score of the player who opened it. A normal raid is unchanged.
now: Keycards hide in boxes and drop from elites, and a vault pays 500 when opened.
